observed: No transient leaf remained observable on the first turn at 1440 or 390.

diagnosis: New instance was asked to flip before Render.start initialized its first-frame clock. The next engine frame treated the animation as expired.
fixUnderTest: Start the flip on the frame immediately after the engine initializes its clock; cancel that pending start during cleanup.
